item.title: King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard Announce New Album Entropy, Two North American Tours
item.description: King Gizzard are back with *Entropy* and not one but two North American tours. Gizzheads, your year just got louder 🦎🎸

item.title: Faith No More Welcome Back Guitarist Trey Spruance for 2027 Reunion Tour
item.description: Faith No More are reuniting with Trey Spruance on guitar for their 2027 tour 🤘 The riffs are coming home!
